title: Duckling dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#2a4a6a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- left foot (raised, dancing) -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='80' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#ff9a00' transform='rotate(-25 34 80)'/>
  <!-- left foot toes -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#ffb733'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='73.5' r='2.5' fill='#ffb733'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='72.5' r='2.5' fill='#ffb733'/>

  <!-- right foot (planted) -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='83' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#ff9a00'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='86' r='2.5' fill='#ffb733'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='87' r='2.5' fill='#ffb733'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='86' r='2.5' fill='#ffb733'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- body shading lit edge -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='68' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- left wing raised up dancing -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='50' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#ffcc00' transform='rotate(35 32 50)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='44' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(35 30 44)'/>

  <!-- right wing out to the side -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='58' rx='13' ry='6' fill='#ffcc00' transform='rotate(-20 70 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='55' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(-20 79 55)'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='15' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='36' r='11' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- little tuft on head -->
  <path d='M50 23 Q52 16 56 20 Q53 22 54 24' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <path d='M47 24 Q46 17 50 19 Q49 22 49 24' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3.2' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='3.2' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- happy cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9a66' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='42' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9a66' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- beak (smiling, open) -->
  <path d='M44 43 Q50 52 57 43 Q56 47 50 48 Q44 47 44 43 Z' fill='#ff8800'/>
  <path d='M44 43 Q47 45 50 45 Q53 45 57 43' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <!-- beak highlight -->
  <path d='M46 44 Q50 47 55 44' stroke='#ffcc66' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <!-- motion lines / dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M20 36 Q18 32 20 28' stroke='#66ddff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M80 38 Q83 34 81 29' stroke='#66ddff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='24' r='1.8' fill='#88eeff'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='22' r='1.8' fill='#88eeff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='2' fill='#aaeeff'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#88eeff'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='53' r='1.5' fill='#88eeff'/>
</svg>
